stances_toward.note: One of the four Indo-Pacific partners (IP4) the Strategic Concept names; Rutte met them for about 30 minutes at Ankara on 7 Jul 2026, with Japan's foreign minister Motegi and defence minister Koizumi attending and agreement to deepen cooperation in defence industry, cyber and advanced technology. Cooling because only one IP4 head of state came (South Korea's Lee), no communique or new political framework emerged and Ankara's declaration does not name the Indo-Pacific, against Vilnius 2023 where the IP4 leaders were named; analysts attribute the downgrade to the US 'NATO 3.0' shift. Partner: cooperation without alignment (no treaty). Bond - affinity: shared concern about Russia-China-North Korea ties.
